tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (341)༄༅/ /rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod chog bdag 'jug dang bcas pa smin grol snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /
(341)༄༅/ /rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod chog bdag 'jug dang bcas pa smin grol snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (341)༄༅// rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod chog bdag 'jug dang bcas pa smin grol snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(342)༄༅// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo lnga// gcig bsdus he ru ka dpal la// gus pas phyag byas de mchod tshul// yang zab snying po 'dir gsal bya/ shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi phyi dkyil la brten pa'i sgrub mchod ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang len par spro na// dam tshig gi bris sku sogs rten yod na bkram pa'i mdun tu maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba dang phyogs bzhir tshom bu'am thig le sngon po re/ mtshams bzhir ser po re bkod pa'i rgyab tu mchod gtor lnga tshom rgyan ldan/ mgon po'i gtor 'bul dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor mdun du mchod thod chang*/ phyi mchod phreng tshar du bsham/ dbang len na maṇ+ḍal steng rkang gsum la bum pa mgul chings sngon po can bcud ldan kha rgyan bcas pa bkod cing khrus chab kyang bsdog /sngon 'gro dkar gtor/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor ba rnams kyang 'du bya'o// de nas sngon gtor/ badz+ra -i mra ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i rgya tsho chen por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros// phyogs skyong ba bcu gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa lha klu gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ(343)a kā ro lan gsum gyis phul/ ār+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po gzhan dag la// sa 'di bdag gis blang bar bgyi// dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag dkyil 'khor gyi las brtsam na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag stsol zhing phan pa dang bde ba'i sems kyis stong grogs khyad par can mdzad du gsol/ gang dag sdang ba dang gdug ba'i sems dang ldan pa log par lta ba'i bgegs dang*/

log par 'dren pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /ces brjod la tsham rngams dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas gtor ma phyir dor a mṛ ta'i sngags brjod do// mchod pa byin brlab ni/ gong ltar bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai bi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes (344) brjod la rol mo bya/ de nas skyabs sems dang*/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs nas brtsam/ bzlas pa bsdu ldangs kyi bar gtso bsdus kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs par byas la/ mdun dkyil bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis srung 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sogs bdag bskyed ltar la/ yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal he ru ka sogs nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// phyogs bzhi'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma rnams la/ shar du gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog sngon po nas/ rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ ltor dgyes mdzad rdo rje mthing ga nas/ drag po mnan pa'o// nub tu ma hā mā yā mthing ga nas/ mi ro mnan pa'o// byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed mthing nag nas/ ma he mnan pa'o// mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa thod pas kha brgyan pa rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/

ye shes pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ gsang mchod dang de kho na nyid mchod dran tsam bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ /ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar sbyar/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs gong ltar byas la/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri bā re bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ mchod yon zhes pa'i gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ ār+ghaṃ zhes pa'i gnas su pā d+yaṃ zhes pa sbyar la chu gnyis 'bul/ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang*// gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni// bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyi// so sor (345)bzhes te rab dgyes mdzod/ gong gi sngags mthar/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin tu/ yid dga' snying po ro mchog ldan// bdug pa bla med dri mchog 'di// bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyi// so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ dhū pe= srin po 'joms shing dag byed la// dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di// bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyi// so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ ā lo ke= gtsang zhing gtsang la dag pa'i dri// skye gnas gtsang mar ldan dri rnams// bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyi/ so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ gan+dhe/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yi gar 'ong*// sngags kyi zhal zas mchog 'di dag /bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyi// so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ nai bi d+ya= pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u sogs// dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs rnams// yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs pa// 'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/

shab+da= gos zung bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi na bza' bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde// srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi// na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul// bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /sngags mthar/ badz+ra wa s+t+rā ya āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ wī ṇi badz+ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du waṃ se= mṛ taṃ gi= mu ra dze= hā s+ya= lā s+ya= gī rti= ni rti= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= rū pa= ra sa= spar+she/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+rī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rig ma bcu drug dang*/ 'khor lo rin chen glang po rta// btsun mo dmag dpon blon po dang*// nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun bcas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ sngags mthar/ shap+ta rat+na pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ zhes rgyal srid dang*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang*// 'dod yon lnga yi mchod sprin 'di// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// thugs rjes (446)dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ sngags mthar/ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ zhes 'dod yon 'bul/ nang mchod sgrub thabs ltar byin brlabs la/ rdo rje 'chang dang dpal gyi ne gu ma// khyung po dzo ki rat+na bīr+ya sogs// rin chen brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zab gsang rgyud sde lnga yi bcud bsdus pa// tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba'i smin grol lam// dngos su 'doms mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rnam dag= /'khor lo bde mchog gsang 'dus dges mdzad dang*// sgyu ma chen mo rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la// rnam dag=

/myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs mgon re ma tī// k+ṣe tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang*// ṭā k+ki rā dza bdud mgon traka shad la// rnam dag= /phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu yi dbang po dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong tshogs// gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag ma lus la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ snying po drug la 'bru gsum btags pa rnams dang*/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri bā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nān bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag /'gro ba rigs drug dang bcas pa la mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yang 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi myang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes lha thams cad bde stong gi mnyes par bsam/ de thams cad 'khor gsum mi dmigs pas rgyas btab ste/ 'dir ni thog ma dbus mtha' med// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ ces de kho na nyid kyis mchod do// bstod pa ni/ oṃ/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me dpung lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings/ (347)mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal// sku la gzi brjid phyag stong ldan pa po// dgra sta zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa sku la gsol// sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud/ bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo chen mo ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen pos 'joms// rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang byed las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma// rmugs byed rengs byed rmongs byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa la sogs skem zhing pham par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud/

hūm̐/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs yongs su bskor// nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su bsgrub// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu mas byang chub sgrub pa'i yid// dges mdzad rdo rje dpal chen he ru ka la bstod// mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che// sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// bka' yi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// bdud dang mu stegs lha min bcom// gshin rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// chos nyid las bzhengs ye shes sku// dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam pa'i dpal// mngon byang ye shes (348)longs spyod rdzogs// ya mān+ta kar phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo khyod// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// sangs rgyas kun mchog gtso bo'i gtso// dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin brlabs la/ snying po rnams kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod phrin bcol bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la 'das gtor 'bul/ myur mdzad mgon po'i gtor 'bul nyung bsdus bya// spyi gtor ni/ phaiṃ/ badz+ra ā ra l+li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes 'byung po thams cad spyan drangs/

oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa/ ub+dā da/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇān+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thaiṃ baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ bhuñdza tha/ pi pa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā rā ta ya/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha sa ha yi kā bha ban+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phyi nang gi mchod pa 'bul/ dam tshig ldan zhing 'jig rten skyong*// srid pa gsum na gang gnas pa// 'gro ba'i don kun spyod pa la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ ces bstod/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong la// bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i gtor ma dang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang*// mtha' yas sems can ma lus la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// yon tan phrin las rgyas par shog / ces 'dod don spyir gsol/ kol+la i reṭaṭha a bol+la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko la/ gha ṇa i ki pi ṭa ho badz+dza i/ ka ru ṇi ka a i ṇa ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khā dz+dza i/ gā ḍo ma a ṇā bedz+dza a i/ ha le kā liñdza ra pa ṇi a i/ dun+du ra badz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma kas+thu ri sih+lā/ ka spu ra lā i a i/ ma lā i in+dha ṇa/ sā li dza a i/ ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i/ phreṅkha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dha ṇa ma ṇa a i/ ni rang+shu aṅge tsa ḍā bi a i/ ta hi dza sa ra ba āp+pa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dzi kun+tu ru bā ḍā i/ ḍiṇ+ḍi ma ta heṃ ṇa badz+dza a i/ (249) zhes rdo rje glu blangs/ yig brgya brjod/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā bā nāṃ/ zhes 'jig rten pa rang gnas su gshegs la gtor ma phyir dor ro// de nas bdag 'jug len na skabs 'dir bya ste// rnam bum la dmigs nas snying po rnams ci 'grub bzla/ a mṛ tas byin gyis brlabs pa'i chus khrus bya zhing*/

maṇ+ḍal bka' rgya ma 'bul/ gsol 'debs ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag kyang 'jug par 'tshal/ lan gsum/ rgyun bshags ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum/ sdom bzung ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// ji tsam dus nas bzung nas su// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su// nam zhig byang chub snying po la// yongs su gnas kyi bar dag tu// bdag gis byang chub mchog gi sems// ma lus par ni bskyed par bgyi// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsam ste bzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhin rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las (350)byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/

ces lan gsum/ gnas gsum du dri bzang gi thig le byas la/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lus gang bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag pa gyur/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re gsal/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ rdo rje me tog dang bcas snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// rdo rje'i sku ru khyod 'grub cing*// mi phyed ye shes thob par 'gyur/ snying gar rdo rje gtugs la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ nang mchod la lcer bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// ye shes bdud rtsis chu 'dis 'grub/ oṃ badz+ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka hūm̐/ yang rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal ba// gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan par gyis// gal te nga la brnyas na ni// sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pa yin// mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas// dmyal ba chen por 'gyur ta re/ (351) zhes brjod/ ye shes pa dbab pa gsol 'debs ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la// rdo rje ye shes bla med ni// di ring nyid du dbab tu gsol/ gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las/ de dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/

lus thams cad gang*/ lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur// yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dpa' mo chos skyong gi lha tshogs thams cad kyang rgyud sde lnga'i rnam par sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam spyan drangs te rang gi lus la sib sib thim par gyur/ spos rol bya zhing rgyud sde lnga'i snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes btags la ye shes phab// de dag gis sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub nas dngos gzhi'i don tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ bsam gyis mi khyab dam chos snod// dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol/ gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rnam bum blangs la/ mdun bskyed rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis phyag tu bum pa bzung ste spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur// skyob pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du// til gyi gong bu bzhin gang ba'i// rgyal bas bum pa bzung nas ni// 'di nyid du ni dbang bskur ro/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ spyi bo gang*/ bum dbang thob/ lus sgrib dag /yul snang stong gi lta ba rgyud la skyes par gyur/ bum pa mgor bzhag /bum chu 'thor 'thung bya// bum chu la mngar gsum sbyar myang la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkha' mnyam ye shes bdud rtsi ni// rdo rje'i lam nas phyung nas kyang*// bde ba bskyed phyir rigs kyi yum// sras bcas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ gsang rdzas khar byin pas/ mgrin pa gang*/ gsang dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag /sgra grags stong gi lta ba rgyud la skyes par gyur// rang snang lha sku yab yum snyoms par zhugs (352)pa'i bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skyes par gyur/ bum chu snying gar 'thor la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ra pradzña dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/

zhes sngags kyi bum chus dbang bskur bas snying ga yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob// yid sgrib dag /rang rig bde stong brjod bral gyi lta ba rgyud la skyes par gyur/ dbang bzhi pa'i gsol gdab ni/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyang du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ oṃ badz+ra tsa tu ra a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ bum chu 'thor/ zhes gsung zhing sngags kyi bum chus dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob// sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag /'dzin rtog thams cad dang bral bar// brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i lta ba rgyud la skyes par gyur/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gtong rag maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod par bya'o// skabs 'di'i bum pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rten tsam yin pas bum sgrub rgyas pa mi dgos so// bdag 'jug byed min gang ltar tshogs mchod ni/ byin rlabs nas lhag ma btang ba'i bar bde mchog lha lnga ltar byas la/ rjes chog mchod kha gsos// mchod pa byin brlab/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sngags tsam gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ sgrub thabs ltar/ chos dbyings rnam dag sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag cag la thugs brtse ba chen por mdzad de bar chad zhi ba dang dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum/ sngags dman pa dang cho ga dman// bya ba dman pa gang gyur pa// zab dang mchog gi bdag nyid gtso// lha mo de dag bzod mdzad rigs// lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis// bdag la rjes (353)su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/ ces nongs bshags dang smon lam bya/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol bya/ kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan// bdag gi dge ba 'dis thob ste// 'gro kun gyis kyang thob par shog /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas nas gang spyod pa// byang chub rdo rjes bsngags pa yi// spyod pa de gnyis bdag spyod shog /ces dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis bka' rgya ma'am/ bsdu na/ legs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs pa// bla ma yi dam bkra shis shog /phrin las thams cad sgrub mdzad pa// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod do// rgyud dang grub chen thams cad kyi// gdams zab snying po'i lam mchog 'dir// zhugs nas skye bo ma lus pa// dkyil 'khor lnga po myur 'grub shog /ces pa'ang rang gzhan 'jug bde'i phyir dang*/ sgrub bla ma tshab tsha bstan 'dzin rdo rje nas bskul ba'i ngor/ shangs pa bka' brgyud la mos pa lam du byed pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis mkhas grub khyung po'i dus chen gyi nyin mor gdan sa chen po dpal spungs kyi yang khrod sgrub pa'i dben khang du brgyud pa'i gsung byin rlabs dang ldan pa 'ba' zhig legs par bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/// /
